description: This PHP class 'EmailProcessor' is an entity representing a database table 'ohrm_email_processor'. It is part of the ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) layer using Doctrine annotations, defining properties like 'id', 'email' (association to Email entity), and 'className'. It includes getter and setter methods for these properties, indicating it models a database record related to email processing within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailProcessor
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the 'ohrm_email_processor' table, representing email processing configuration with properties for ID, associated email, and an optional class name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email processor.
